question: In which of the following years was the Cornwallis Code introduced?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1793.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** East India Company** passed the **Cornwallis Code in 1793** to enhance the** administration of its Indian colonies.**
 
• Under the direction of** Charles, Earl (Lord) Cornwallis**, the Code was created.
 
• He presided over **Bengal as governor** from **1786 to 1793.**
 
• The code included important rules for** governance, law enforcement, and judicial and civil administration.**
 
• The** Permanent Settlement **was its most well-known provision.
 
• Permanent settlement established a** revenue collection scheme** that lasted until the 20th century.
 
• Initiated in** Bengal**, the system eventually covered the entirety of northern India after a number of laws dated** May 1, 1793** were issued.
 
• Up to the** Charter Act of 1833**, British India's administration essentially did nothing but rest on these. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **British Parliament** approved the **Charter Act of 1833.**
 
• **It **extended the **East India Company's charter** for an additional **20 years.**
 
• The **Saint Helena Act 1833** or the** Government of India Act 1833 **were other names for this.
 
• The** colonization of India by the British** was made **lawful** by the charter act of 1833.
 
• It turned the East India Company into an** administrative organization,** ending its commercial operations.
 
• It said that the government would hold the **company's Indian territories **"in trust for His Majesty, His heirs and successors."
